commit.message:
Build riscv64 wheels on Linux

Add a native riscv64 row to the wheel build matrix, following the
existing native ubuntu-24.04-arm (aarch64) and windows-11-arm (ARM64)
rows. The job runs on the ubuntu-24.04-riscv runner provided by
RISC-V GitHub Runners [1].

The legacy cibuildwheel 3.x step is skipped on riscv64: it always uses
actions/setup-python, which has no riscv64 interpreters, and Python 3.8
has no riscv64 manylinux build identifier in cibuildwheel 4.x either.
cibuildwheel 4.x falls back to the runner's python3 on riscv64 and
builds and tests the CPython 3.9+ wheels.

Also add riscv64 to the default Linux archs in pyproject.toml so local
cibuildwheel runs match CI.

[1]: https://ci.riseproject.dev/
